name: Sai Life Sciences Ltd.
about: Sai Life Sciences Limited operates as a contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CRDMO) in India and internationally. It offers medicinal chemistry, pharmacokinetics, clinical and commercial manufacturing, and process development services. The company was formerly known as SAI Advantium Pharma Limited and changed its name to Sai Life Sciences Limited in July 2006. Sai Life Sciences Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~47% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~21% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 13.7% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 102 vs sector median 53; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 62, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2024, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 119% a year while PE moved 181 → 102.
